title: Run live 2/5-worker portfolio pin contention canary
mission: Verify the deterministic portfolio pin protocol against real GitHub-backed simultaneous /wc contention. Exercise 2-worker and 5-worker same-job/same-generation races, durable loser collision receipts, loser re-entry, recovery-generation predecessor lineage and Live projection. Do not change product surfaces or promote production /w.
definition_of_done: A live 2-worker same-job/same-generation contention produces exactly one winning pin and one prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 loser receipt; loser creates no execution claim and re-enters allocation.
A live 5-worker same-job/same-generation contention produces exactly one winning pin and four durable loser collision receipts; losers create no duplicate execution claims and re-enter allocation.
A live recovery-generation contention preserves predecessor_pin_ref and still yields exactly one winner plus durable loser receipts.
Live projection exposes one authority owner, collision count, recovery/stale semantics and terminal precedence from produced durable evidence.
Verification result remains /wc canary evidence and explicitly does not self-promote production /w.
